summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing minutes of a Board of Directors meeting held July 31, 2026. The board unanimously approved the exoneration (removal) of Vice-President Executive Officer Maria Elena Lanciego Perez. No details were provided regarding the reason for departure, severance, or transition plans. The filing is a routine disclosure of an executive change under Rule 13a-16. The event is a specific, announced removal of a senior officer, though the context and significance are not elaborated. What to watch: whether further disclosures clarify succession or strategic implications.
